text: Now that N=128 m2-fixed probes_final exist, the N=128 to N=256 force-control changes for seeds 20/21 are -0.011 (0.630 to 0.620) and +0.070 (0.583 to 0.652). Across all paired N=128/N=256 seeds, with both m2 settings, is the per-seed control change more variable than the within-run control_spread (0.02-0.05)? If so, n_controls=3 is too few to decompose force-margin changes across N.
